```sql
SELECT SUM(ch.population)
FROM main."country_history" ch
JOIN main."country" c ON ch.code = c."Code"
WHERE c."Continent" = 'Asia'
  AND ch.effective_month <= '2026-05'
  AND ch.code IN (
    SELECT code
    FROM main."country_history"
    WHERE effective_month <= '2026-05'
      AND code = ch.code
    ORDER BY effective_month DESC
    LIMIT 1
  )
  AND ch.effective_month = (
    SELECT MAX(effective_month)
    FROM main."country_history"
    WHERE code = ch.code
      AND effective_month <= '2026-05'
  )
```
